tools.name: list_leagues
tools.description: List the leagues this API monitors live, with the sport and league slugs every other tool needs. 29 leagues monitored live: NFL, college football, NBA, men's college basketball, MLB, NHL and 23 soccer competitions.

tools.name: get_live_events
tools.description: Games in progress right now for a league, with score, period/clock and status. Empty list when nothing is live. Data is typically 20-30 s behind live play.

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: The league's current scoreboard window: recent, live and upcoming games. For specific dates or weeks use get_schedule.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Full details for one game: teams, score, status, venue, season/week, broadcasts, officials.

tools.name: get_plays
tools.description: Play-by-play for a game, oldest first, paginated. Use a larger limit (up to 300 here) to get more plays per call; check pagination.hasNextPage.

tools.name: get_box_score
tools.description: Team totals and player statistics for a game (basketball, soccer, baseball, football). Not available before kickoff.

tools.name: get_odds
tools.description: Current spread, moneyline and total for a game from a single source book. Returns null when no odds are available.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Games in a date range (start_date/end_date, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 31 days, US Eastern calendar days like most US schedules) or, for NFL and college football, a season week (season + week). Up to 200 games.

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: Teams in a league (paginated; college football has 800+ teams across divisions).

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: One team: names, record, standing summary, venue.

tools.name: get_team_roster
tools.description: Current roster for a team, grouped by position.

tools.name: search_athletes
tools.description: Find players by name within a league; returns athlete ids and teams.

tools.name: get_injuries
tools.description: Current injury report grouped by team (empty in the off-season). Pass team_id for that team's complete report.

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Latest news headlines for a league (optionally one team), with links.
